title: Lenient online return policies and purchase intention through trust
statement:
More lenient online return policies can increase purchase intention through consumer trust, making clear and usable return terms a defensible objection-handling element rather than merely a post-purchase service detail. (Hanken School of Economics)

Options:
- 30-day return: 30-day-return-summary (fits: standard, low clutter, risk reducing)
- 60-day return: 60-day-return-summary (fits: generous, high consideration, confidence building)
- Free returns: free-return-shipping (fits: friction reducing, high return effort, risk reducing)
- Easy policy access: one-click-return-policy-link (fits: transparent, mobile first, self service)
- Policy near CTA: return-policy-card-near-cta (fits: high consideration, objection handling, conversion focused)
appliesWhen: Applies to: ecommerce, online retail, consumer goods, marketplaces. Audience: adults, general.

source.title: Online purchase return policy leniency and purchase decision: Mediating role of consumer trust
source.authors: Pejvak Oghazi; Stefan Karlsson; Daniel Hellström; Klas Hjort
source.venue: Journal of Retailing and Consumer Services
